findings.motion: On adoption of amendment #409 to H.4000 (FY2026 budget), An Act relative to identification to vote; rejected 25 yeas to 131 nays (Yea and Nay No. 42)
findings.note: McMurtry is recorded N on the roll call sheet. The amendment text (https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H4000/409/House/Content) would require each voter to show valid State or Federal photo identification before receiving a ballot, list acceptable IDs (driver's license, passport, military ID, firearm ID card, other government photo ID), direct the Secretary of the Commonwealth to give a free photo ID to a registered voter without one who signs an affidavit, and take effect January 1, 2026.
